feeds.title: Global Arbitration News
feeds.description: Global Arbitration News is a news platform which keeps you updated on the latest legislation and court decisions on arbitration-related topics. Global Arbitration News is moderated by Baker & McKenzie.

feeds.title: Kluwer Arbitration Blog
feeds.description: Kluwer Arbitration Blog (KAB) is a publication of Kluwer Law International providing information and news on international arbitration. We have gathered together leading experts from law firms, arbitration institutions, and academia to report on the latest developments.

feeds.title: International Arbitration Attorney Blog
feeds.description: The International Arbitration Attorney Network provides free access to international arbitration information and answers questions concerning arbitration.

feeds.title: The Arbitration Law Forum Blog
feeds.description: We formed Loree & Loree to offer clients an alternative that combines some of the best things that big firms can offer with some of the best things that small firms can offer, without burdening clients with the principal disadvantages of each business model. In the matters we undertake, we strive to provide the same or better level of service, quality and skill that clients expect from large, big-city firms.

feeds.title: The Arbitration Workshop
feeds.description: The Arbitration Workshop is a blog that aims at discussing the practical workings of Arbitration in India and across the Globe.

feeds.title: Arbitrate
feeds.description: The world's leading community and online resource network for everything in Arbitration. A sibling site to http://mediate.com, arbitrate.com offers an online newsletter (Arbitration Today) a web interview series (the Arbitration Conversation), practice tips (Arbitration TNT - Tips N Tools) alongside featured articles, daily news updates, and a geographic directory of practitioners.

feeds.title: Arbitration & Corporate Law Review Blog
feeds.description: The Arbitration & Corporate Law Review's blog page consists of articles, research pieces, opinions, case comments, and short notes on Company law, Insolvency law, Securities law, Competition law, Arbitration Law, Law of Taxation, IPR, Trade Law and Employment law.

feeds.title: Ananya Pratap Singh
feeds.description: This is Ananya Pratap Singh, an Indian lawyer and arbitrator, currently engaged with CSL Chambers, Delhi.My area of work includes advising primarily in the areas of international commercial arbitration, international dispute settlement, adjudication, security & insolvency law and contract. I also advice on matters related with mergers & Acquisition, business torts, international & commercial trust law, and international tax law.

feeds.title: Practical Law Arbitration Blog
feeds.description: Practical Law Arbitration provides know-how in relation to all aspects of arbitration procedure, both in relation to England and Wales domestic arbitration and international arbitration. It also features information on drafting arbitration clauses, institutional and ad hoc arbitration, awards and challenges, and investment treaty arbitration.

feeds.title: ArbitrationNation
feeds.description: A resource for litigators, in-house counsLiz Kramer author of ArbitrationNation covers key principles of modern arbitration law, to help people and parties better understand how arbitration works and make informed decisions in their contracts and disputes.el, and arbitrators

feeds.title: Singapore International Arbitration Blog
feeds.description: This blog is about resolving disputes through international arbitration in Singapore. The blog is written by experienced practitioners within Holborn Law LLC and CMS well regarded international arbitration group in Singapore who provide clients with world-class service and engage to solve complex business issues involving different cultures and diverse places.

feeds.title: Securities Arbitration Alert Blog
feeds.description: Securities Arbitration Alert focuses exclusively on the practice and process of securities and commodities arbitration. This link-rich publication reports on events and developments, rule changes, tactical matters, noteworthy Awards, and arbitration case law within a financial services context.

feeds.title: EFILA Blog
feeds.description: The European Federation for Investment Law Blog is intended to offer a common space that fosters dialogue between specialists of different views in an effective and user-friendly manner, allowing discussions to move beyond the stalemate of isolated monologues that fail to truly address the salient issues of the moment. Therefore, the Blog is meant to provide a balanced view that attempts to avoid any hegemonic assumptions.

feeds.title: Modo Resolutio
feeds.description: Alternative Dispute Resolution- Simplified! With this blog we intend to acquaint and bring, not only law students and legal practitioners, but each and every person closer to ADR.

feeds.title: Herbert Smith Freehills
feeds.description: Herbert Smith Freehills' new arbitration know-how and news blog where you will find the latest developments on international arbitration topics.
